tool_schemas.name: list_calendars
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calendars available in ChronaSchedule Hub along with the current count of events in each calendar. This endpoint refuses requests only when the service cannot enumerate calendars (for example, if calendars are unavailable), and it reports that listing is not possible rather than returning partial results.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0061000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0061000") else "/app/database")
def list_calendars():
    import json, os
    cals = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, "calendars.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    return [{"name": k, "events": len(v)} for k, v in cals.items()]

tool_schemas.name: get_events
tool_schemas.description: Returns events from the named calendar, optionally limited to those that fall within the provided ISO 8601 datetime range. It refuses requests when the calendar_name does not exist, when start or end is not a valid ISO datetime, or when the range is invalid (such as start occurring after end).

tool_schemas.name: find_events
tool_schemas.description: Searches the named calendar and returns events whose summary contains the provided substring. It refuses requests when the calendar_name does not exist or when summary_contains is empty or not provided, because it cannot perform a meaningful match.

summary_contains.description: Substring to match in event summary.

tool_schemas.name: add_event
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new event in the named calendar and returns the created event’s UID. It refuses requests when the calendar does not exist, when required fields (summary, dtstart, dtend) are missing or empty, when dtstart/dtend are not valid ISO datetimes or dtend is not after dtstart, or when an explicit uid is provided that conflicts with an existing event in that calendar.

tool_schemas.name: delete_event
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the event with the given UID from the named calendar and returns a confirmation of the deletion. It refuses requests when the calendar does not exist, when no event with that UID is present in the calendar, or when the UID is missing or empty so the target event cannot be identified.

tool_schemas.name: create_calendar
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new empty calendar with the given name and returns the created calendar. It refuses requests when name is missing or empty, or when a calendar with the same name already exists, because calendar names must be unique within the service.

metadata.name: ChronaSchedule Hub
metadata.description: A calendar platform service that lets users create and manage multiple calendars and add, search, list, and delete scheduled events across them.
